figures.caption: Figure 2: (left) Scaled Dot-Product Attention. (right) Multi-Head Attention consists of several attention layers running in parallel.
figures.key_insight: The figure illustrates scaled dot-product attention and how multiple attention heads are run in parallel and then concatenated and linearly projected.

code_locations.rationale: This is the core multi-head attention module. It creates per-head projection variables wqkv and wo, invokes the forward pass, and returns the multi-head output, matching the figure’s parallel attention heads and output projection.
This code performs the scaled dot-product attention computation: logits are formed, softmax produces attention weights, and the weighted sum over values is computed with tf.matmul(weights, v).

Although for graph attention rather than the Transformer figure specifically, it explicitly shows splitting q/k/v into separate heads, processing each head in parallel, and combining the head outputs, which parallels the multi-head attention diagram.

figures.code_mapping_summary: Implements multi-head scaled dot-product attention: each head computes attention scores via softmax over dot products, applies them to values, and the heads are combined through parallel projection parameters in the multihead attention module.
